title: Combined attach accepted by the network

entities.name: Combined Attach Procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure for accepting combined EPS and non-EPS services attach request from UE.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to indicate successful combined attach procedure.

entities.name: ATTACH COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to confirm successful attach procedure completion.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state indicating UE is successfully registered with the network.

relations.description: Network sends ATTACH ACCEPT message as part of combined attach procedure
UE responds with ATTACH COMPLETE message to complete the procedure
Successful combined attach procedure establishes EMM-REGISTERED state
